about.heading: About Me
about.text: Greetings! I'm Sha Ariyan, and I navigate the exciting world of web design, where every pixel serves a purpose. Combining a deep understanding of user experience with a knack for transforming ideas into visually stunning interfaces, I approach each project with a burning passion to craft something truly remarkable.

stack.name: Framer
stack.description: Framer revolutionizes my web design workflow. It goes beyond a simple website builder, offering a visual playground where I can craft stunning and interactive websites without getting bogged down in complex code.

stack.name: Figma
stack.description: Figma is my collaborative design platform of choice. I utilize it to work seamlessly with team members and clients, facilitating real-time feedback and design iterations.

stack.name: Notion
stack.description: Notion helps me keep my projects organized. I use it for project management, task tracking, and as a central hub for documentation.

stack.name: Airtable
stack.description: Airtable is my go-to solution for robust data organization with structured databases.

stack.name: Zapier
stack.description: Zapier automates workflows and connects my favorite tools seamlessly.

stack.name: HTML
stack.description: HTML5 is the backbone of my web design work, ensuring semantically meaningful and accessible structure.

stack.name: CSS
stack.description: CSS3 is my styling powerhouse for visually appealing, responsive websites.
